Title: Release of Service Fabric SDK Preview 0.9.0.0 and Runtime Preview 5.6.3.6 for Linux

Body.Content:
Version 0.9.0.0 of the Azure Service Fabric SDK Preview for Linux is now available, along with version 5.6.3.6 of the Service Fabric Runtime Preview for Linux. This is a minor update with several bug fixes and improvements.

Read more about this release on the Service Fabric team blog.
